text:
Xbox CEO Teases a 'Family' of Project Helix Devices - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Speaking with the BBC, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma briefly mentioned a 'family of devices' as part of the upcoming Project Helix next-gen console. No other details were given, but Sharma also spoke about the need for the gaming industry to make strides in 'affordability and efficiency.' Currently, the Xbox Series X generation includes the flagship Series X, the slightly more affordable but less powerful Series S, and the ROG Xbox Ally X handheld developed with ASUS. In related news, preorders for the upcoming Xbox 25th Anniversary Series X are live, and scalpers are already cashing in. The translucent green console with matching controller has already sold for thousands of dollars on eBay, a striking contrast to the retail price of around $900. And we’re riding Mine Cart Madness inside Super Nintendo World with The Ride Guys at Universal Epic Universe at Universal Orlando Resort.
 
Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.

text:
How LEGO Changes The Much-Loved Skylines Formula | gamescom 2026
Merging the playful building of LEGO with the city-building and management of City Skylines, LEGO Skylines is a merging of two styles that just feels right. We caught up with Game Director and Co-Founder of Iceflake Studios; Lasse Liljedahl and Art Director, Jonna Liikanen to learn more about LEGO Skylines. Who was the target player for this spin-off? How much of CIty Skylines flavour did they get in? Have they managed to nail the tactile satisfying feeling of building with LEGO in real life? We ask all that and more! 

LEGO Skylines is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.

text:
LOTR's Pippin is Your Ghost-Busting Sidekick in There Are No Ghosts at The Grand | gamescom 2026
There Are No Ghosts at The Grand lets you live out your fantasy of renovating a hotel, that just so happens to be haunted. We sat down to chat with Anil Glendinning, creative director and writer, and Lord of the Rings legend himself, Billy Boyd… well sorta. We got the inside track on ghost hunting, the challenges in juggling horror, musical numbers and making a fun renovation game, working with Alex Brightman, and how the open world plays! It won’t be long before you can start renovating and ghost hunting at the Grand as There Are No Ghosts at The Grand launches in December 2026 for PC (Steam, Xbox on PC) and Xbox Series X|S.

text:
FC 27: Is The Grounds the Biggest Game Changer Since Ultimate Team? | gamescom 2026
EA Sports FC 27 is introducing The Grounds, an all new social space that embodies the shared love of Football from around the world. With three districts inspired by global football cultures, you’ll be able to jump in with up to 100 other players and experience small-sided football matches, kickabouts and more! 

We chatted to Karthik Venkateshan, and Jean-Francois Guastalla from EA to learn more about this all new mode, touching on how big The Grounds is compared to Ultimate Team, the decision making around the districts and what the thought process was behind choosing these cultural touchpoints, and of course what the long-term plan is for The Grounds. 

You’ll be able to have a kickabout down the local district park yourself, when EA Sports FC 27 launches PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, EA App) and Xbox Series X|S.
